column1: # Lucene 10.5.0 lucene-analysis-common: every top-level class of the jar, and what became of it.
# Checked by scripts/check-port-inventory.py --module analysis-common (see its docstring for the statuses).
# M11 ships in parts; every class not yet ported is todo:M11 tagged with the M11 task that takes it

column3: T11.7 factory/SPI: CustomAnalyzer (its Builder is configured by factory names and classes)
entry sorting is in memory (SortingStrategy.inMemory()); the offline variant only bounds JVM heap while loading
WordStorage already keeps its entries in plain vectors (the cache's layout); withSuggestibleEntryCache would only copy them, and changes no suggestion

ThaiAnalyzer: ThaiTokenizer is java.text.BreakIterator's dictionary word breaking for Thai, whose dictionary is GPL-licensed JDK data; M12 takes Thai with ICU
ThaiTokenizer: BreakIterator.getWordInstance(th) is the JDK's GPL-licensed Thai dictionary; M12 (ICU)
CharArrayIterator: the CharacterIterator SegmentingTokenizerBase feeds BreakIterator; M12
SegmentingTokenizerBase: its tokenizers (Thai, smartcn, ICU) run java.text.BreakIterator; M12 ports it with them
CollationDocValuesField: java.text.Collator sort keys (JDK locale data); M12 (ICU collation)
CollationKeyAnalyzer: java.text.Collator sort keys (JDK locale data); M12 (ICU collation)
